purpose: Qualify saved preferences, actual scope/override/argv binding and unchanged original-design/native checks; not a comparative routing gain.

acceptance: Each actual route must pass existing original-design/native acceptance and central readback. Exact presets, effective scope/budget/profile/scoring and complete engine argv must match. Preserve every failure; no automatic retry or constraint relaxation.

resources: One sequential native/engine worker, existing per-route caps/2GiB heap/4GiB group polling. Additional outer process receipts include exit/wall/waited-child CPU and cleanup. No benchmark claim or paid services.
